mapper.select: select id, tenant_id, category, item_code, item_name, parent_id, item_type, status, attributes, created_at, updated_at, deleted from master_data_item where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and category = #{category} and deleted = 0 order by parent_id asc, id asc
mapper.update: update master_data_item set item_name = #{itemName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, item_type = #{itemType}, status = #{status}, attributes = #{attributes}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and category = #{category} and deleted = 0
